sentences.text:

For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. Rishu Ranjan, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Vishwanath Roy, A.P.P.
 ----
 06/Dated: 20th April, 2023
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicants who are in custody since 16.10.2022 have approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Patratu P.S. Case No.192 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 376-D, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned C.J.M.,
Ramgarh.
3. It appears that the applicants are accused of committing rape upon the victim.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicants and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.

It has been submitted that the girl is major and she has clearly stated in her statement made under Section 164 Cr.P.C. that these applicants have not committed Sanjay Kumar Bhuiyan @ Sanjay Bhuiyan vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63104399/
1 rape rather she was having a consensual relationship with one of the co-accused.

entities.text: Sanjay Kumar Bhuiyan @ Sanjay Bhuiyan vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
On the above basis,
prayer for bail has been made.
6. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
7. Considering the above facts, I am inclined to enlarge the applicants on bail.

Accordingly, the applicants, named above, are directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned C.J.M., Ramgarh in connection with Patratu P.S. Case No.192 of 2022,

subject to condition that the applicant(s) will submit self-attested photocopy/photocopies of his/her/their Aadhaar Card(s) and also submit his/her/their mobile number(s) before the learned court below which he/she/they will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
